_comment: Capability-root manifest for messaging/ (ADR-0562). Every crate, capability file path, fixture path and accounting count below was read off the tree at authoring time, not transcribed from legacy microservices/ or libs/oya-messaging-* dump paths.
_tier_subtype_note: UNGROUNDED — capability-registry declares no tier_subtype and no absorbed legacy service manifest provides one. Deliberately ABSENT rather than invented; it lands when a grounded subtype exists.
purpose: Event bus / messaging substrate (ADR-0536 D-13): ONE owned substrate port (`messaging-substrate-kernel`), queue/stream/bus boundary kernels composed over it, transactional outbox domain + CloudEvent envelope, and a file-backed outbox adapter. Apache Pulsar is the validated transitional broker behind the port (ADR-0510); no deployed broker runtime, REST server, measured SLO, or OpenSLO file is claimed by this capability-root slice.
